resources.string: Android System WebView needs an update
Stagehand draws its Setup page with Android System WebView, and this version (%1$s) lacks what it needs. Update Android System WebView from the Play Store, then open Stagehand again.
Android System WebView is out of date
Foundry VTT 14 needs Android System WebView %1$d or newer; this phone has %2$s. Foundry may warn about it or misbehave until you update it from the Play Store.

The server at %1$s uses a certificate this phone doesn\'t trust, often a self-signed one. Stagehand doesn\'t open such servers yet: use the server\'s plain http address on your home network, or give it a certificate from a public authority.

Foundry asks for the administrator password set in its configuration. A server without one opens Setup straight away; one with a world running opens the running page.
